## 問題
2025 年第一季有效訂單中，使用 WELCOME10 的占比是多少？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 14.44
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，以不重複 order_id 計張數。以 order_ts 篩選 2025-01-01 至 2025-03-31，有效訂單共 11,901 張，其中 coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' 者 1,718 張，占比 14.44%。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_id, order_ts, status, coupon_code FROM orders LIMIT 10", "SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE coupon_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY coupon_code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_id, order_ts, status, coupon_code FROM orders LIMIT 10', 'columns': ['order_id', 'order_ts', 'status', 'coupon_code'], 'rows': [[1, '2025-05-27 02:32:55', 3, 'WELCOME10'], [2, '2025-06-01 06:04:51', 3, None], [3, '2025-09-27 08:46:07', 3, None], [4, '2025-04-09 20:13:13', 3,
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) AS welcome10_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS welcome10_share_pct FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['valid_orders', 'welcome10_orders', 'welcome10_share_pct'], 'rows': [[11901, 1718, 14.44]], 'truncated': False}

## 回答 B
最終答案: 14.44
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，有效訂單為 orders.status 為 1（已付款）、2（已出貨）、3（已送達）的訂單，並以不重複 order_id 計張數。以 order_ts 介於 2025-01-01 與 2025-04-01 之間篩選，共 11901 張有效訂單，其中 coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' 為 1718 張，占比 = 1718 / 11901 × 100 = 14.44。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_ts, coupon_code, status FROM orders WHERE order_ts LIKE '2025%' LIMIT 10", "SELECT coupon_code, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE coupon_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY coupon_code ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50"]
  結果: [{'query': "SELECT order_ts, coupon_code, status FROM orders WHERE order_ts LIKE '2025%' LIMIT 10", 'columns': ['order_ts', 'coupon_code', 'status'], 'rows': [['2025-05-27 02:32:55', 'WELCOME10', 3], ['2025-06-01 06:04:51', None, 3], ['2025-09-27 08:46:07', None, 3], ['2025-04-09 20:13:13', None, 3]
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) AS welcome10_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN coupon_code = 'WELCOME10' THEN order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS welcome10_share_pct FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND order_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < '2025-04-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['valid_orders', 'welcome10_orders', 'welcome10_share_pct'], 'rows': [[11901, 1718, 14.44]], 'truncated': False}
